ctbids-49719-5807720.description:
This beautiful estate piece features a classic link chain loaded with an array of individual, highly detailed puffy heart charms, each showcasing its own unique engraved patterns, floral motifs, and textured finishes.
Full of character, history, and vintage charm, this bracelet creates a beautiful, substantial look on the wrist and produces that classic, nostalgic chime with every movement. One of the prominent charms is clearly stamped "STERLING" on the reverse, verifying its precious metal quality.
Perfect for collectors of vintage silver, romantic jewelry, or anyone looking for a unique heirloom piece with a story to tell.
Product Details:
• Material: Sterling Silver (Stamped)
• Style: Vintage / Antique Puffy Heart Charm Bracelet
• Charms: Multiple individual multi-patterned puffy hearts
• Length: Approx. 7.25 inches from end to end
• Weight: 0.865 oz / 24.52 grams
• Closure: Secure spring ring clasp with an attached safety chain
• Condition: Beautiful vintage condition with a rich, natural patina that highlights the intricate details

283547853.description:
Mineral, Crystal, and Fossil Collection Lot
Mixed Gemstones, Carvings, Tumbled Stones, and Authenticated Fossils
Natural Minerals and Fossil Specimens
A diverse mixed lot of natural mineral specimens, carved decorative stones, polished gemstone palm stones, and authentic fossils. This collection features a variety of lapidary styles alongside genuine paleontological specimens, making it suitable for display, study, or lapidary collecting.
Items Included:
Three Late Eocene fossil seed cones (aggregate fruit) from Sahara Desert, Morocco, with FossilEra box and identification card (#277,772)
Polished ammonite fossil half displaying visible internal septa and chambers
Carved black stone cat figurine and small carved stone mushroom
Polished puffy gemstone hearts including rose quartz, tiger's eye, and sodalite
Polished tiger's eye sphere and polished palm stones including malachite, lapis lazuli, and carnelian
Natural raw minerals including pyrite cluster, rough quartz chips, points, and obsidian
Condition:
Natural geological and fossil specimens show inherent natural inclusions, surface texture, and matrix variations. Polished pieces retain smooth reflective surfaces with no major post-production cracks or chips. FossilEra box and specimen card remain intact and legible.
